Author: Xiong W, Li J, Feng Y, Chai J, Wu J, Hu Y, Tian M, Lu W, Xu X, Zou M.
Comments: Mechanism: BR2GK directly inactivated ZIKV by disrupting the integrity of the envelope and may also penetrate the host cell membrane to inhibit the middle stage of ZIKV infection.
Cytotoxicity: [Ref.34960651]exhibited no significant toxicity to Vero, Hela, and Huh7 cells in the concentration range 0-20 µM.
Hemolytic_activity: No hemolysis information or data found in the reference(s) presented in this entry
Name: Brevinin-2GHk(BR2GK)
Target_Organism: [Ref.34960651]Zika Virus: inhibition of infection of Zika virus in Vero cells(IC50=3.408 ± 0.738 μM).
Title: Brevinin-2GHk, a Peptide Derived from the Skin of Fejervarya limnocharis, Inhibits Zika Virus Infection by Disrupting Viral Integrity.
